rollups.text: Jon lost his banker job on 2023-01-19 and decided to pursue a dance business, planning a studio inspired by his lifelong love of dance. On 2023-01-29 he was searching for a location and assessing space and floor quality; by 2023-02-04 finding a suitable location was still difficult. On 2023-02-08 he described running his own studio and teaching dancers of different ages and skill levels, while continuing to acknowledge the challenges of starting the business. On 2023-03-16 he said the business remained tough but that he was living his dream. On 2023-04-03 he had closed his bank account to support the business, was promoting the studio and offering classes and workshops, and planned a May competition. He showcased the studio at a fair on 2023-04-24. By 2023-05-27 he was wrapping up a business plan and seeking investors; on 2023-06-13 he described preparing to open and offering classes, workshops, and mentoring. The studio’s grand opening was scheduled for 2023-06-20, and Jon was preparing for it on 2023-06-19. By 2023-07-21 the studio was on tenuous grounds, so Jon had taken temporary work while seeking investors; he planned to improve his business plan and pitch and build an online platform. He remained determined to continue.

Jon’s efforts to find funding and build business connections progressed from seeking investors while finishing his business plan on 2023-05-27, a search he described as difficult, to networking events on 2023-06-20. By 2023-07-21 he reported that networking had produced good results: at a recent event he met investors and received useful advice. He then planned to improve his business plan and investor pitch and develop an online platform to showcase the studio. The available records span 55 days from the investor search to the reported event results.

Jon began promoting his dance business on social media with dance videos by 2023-06-16. On 2023-07-21, Gina advised using Instagram and TikTok, dance clips, and collaborations with local influencers or dance communities, and offered help creating content and managing the accounts. Jon accepted and suggested they work together on the studio’s public image; they agreed to collaborate on content and social media. This developed over 35 days from Jon posting videos to their agreed collaboration.

Jon’s recorded trips: Paris on 2023-01-28 (reported the next day); Rome during the week of 2023-06-12 to 2023-06-18 (reported on 2023-06-19). The records do not establish any further details about the trips.

Jon’s recorded dance activities and milestones: his dance crew won first place in a local competition in 2022; he agreed to a dance session with Gina on 2023-01-27; he rehearsed with a small group for a nearby festival in February 2023 and later said he performed at the festival on 2023-02-08; he prepared for a March 2023 competition; he showcased his studio at a fair on 2023-04-24; he practiced routines and offered Gina a dance video on 2023-05-11; and he was rehearsing on 2023-07-23. The March competition is recorded as preparation, not as a confirmed appearance or result.

Jon’s recorded approaches to tracking goals and progress: a whiteboard to track ideas and milestones on 2023-05-27; a notebook calendar to set goals, track achievements, and identify improvements on 2023-06-13; a whiteboard to visualize goals and record successes on 2023-06-13; color-coding achievements to track progress on 2023-06-13; and writing plans on paper to stay focused on 2023-06-21.
rollups.topic: Business planning and progress tracking tools

rollups.text: Jon’s recorded business-related networking milestones: he attended networking events on 2023-06-20 and reported a recent networking event with investor contacts and useful advice on 2023-07-21. These are two separately dated records of networking activity; the July account does not establish whether it describes a separate event.

Jon’s recorded dance preferences and motivations: he loves all dance styles and particularly favors expressive, powerful contemporary dance (undated); he has practiced contemporary and hip-hop with a group by February 2023; he described dance as an escape and a way to express himself on 2023-02-08; and on 2023-05-11 he said dance had been his stress-buster since childhood and made him feel most alive.

Gina’s clothing-business timeline: In January 2023 she launched an advertising campaign for her clothing store (2023-01-29). By February 1, she had received a positive reply from a wholesaler, designed a cozy, glamorous store, and was working to expand the business (2023-02-01). The store was doing well by February 4; on February 8 she was developing designs with a local artist and working on an online store (2023-02-04..2023-02-08). On March 16 she announced that her online clothing store had opened; on March 23 she described it as demanding but rewarding and focused on trends, branding, and customer relationships (2023-03-16..2023-03-23). By April 3 she had introduced promotions, seen sales increase, and was seeking new customers and considering influencer collaborations and more advertising (2023-04-03). She said on April 25 that she had started the business after losing her job, and on June 16 described growing its customer base while enjoying being her own boss (2023-04-25..2023-06-16). During the week of June 12–18 she made a limited-edition line; on June 21 she said she had acquired new unique pieces (2023-06-12..2023-06-21). On July 21 she reported building a new ordering website and overcoming sourcing challenges through research and networking (2023-07-21).
rollups.topic: Online clothing store and fashion business

rollups.text: After losing her DoorDash job in January 2023, Gina said in March that she was having a tough time, and later explained that losing the job prompted her to start her own business. On May 10 she had an interview for a design internship; on May 27 she said she had been accepted for a part-time internship in the fashion department of an international company. She was excited and somewhat nervous about the change and hoped to learn as much as possible. Elapsed time from the reported job loss in January to internship acceptance on May 27 was about four months.

Gina’s dance history and continuing connection to dance: She recalled winning first place with her team at a regional competition when she was 15, performing the emotional contemporary piece “Finding Freedom” (date of competition not given). On January 27, 2023, she and Jon agreed to meet for a dance session. In April she recalled taking dance classes and described dance as a source of self-expression and happiness; on May 11 she called it her stress fix and said she could not picture life without it. In June she said she had once had a dance mentor, and in July she attended a dance class with friends and reflected on the importance of creative spaces for dancers.

Gina’s collaboration with Jon on his dance-studio promotion: On July 21, 2023, she advised him to use Instagram and TikTok, share dance content, and collaborate with local influencers or dance communities; she offered to create content and manage the studio’s social media. Jon accepted, and they enthusiastically agreed to collaborate on the studio’s content and public image. This follows months of Gina encouraging Jon’s studio plans, including advising him about marketing and networking.

Gina’s fashion-business work and offerings: clothing store and advertising campaign (2023-01-29); store design, furniture, and chandelier (2023-02-01); online-store designs developed with a local artist, inspired by a fashion magazine (2023-02-08); online clothing store opened (2023-03-16); store promotions and offers (2023-04-03); limited-edition clothing line created during the week of June 12–18 (2023-06-12..2023-06-18); new unique pieces acquired, including a personal-collection hoodie that was not for sale (2023-06-21); online ordering website built (2023-07-21).

Gina’s stated reasons for and benefits of dance: she enjoys expressive, graceful contemporary dance (date not specified); dance relieves stress and helps her express herself (2023-04-03; 2023-05-11); dance feels essential to her and makes her worries vanish (2023-05-11); she has described dance as freedom to express herself without worrying what others think, a sentiment represented by a tattoo she got a few years before February 8, 2023.
Gina reported visiting Rome once and said she had never had a chance to visit Paris (2023-01-29).
